title: IIT Patna Notification 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Fellow posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow positions. Candidates who have qualified in post-graduation can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Patna Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last date of application....
